This FloPlast push-fit 2-boss 92.5° double socket access branch is a vital component for soil and vent systems, providing essential access for inspection and maintenance. Constructed from durable uPVC, this black 110mm branch offers strength and reliability for plumbing installations. Its lightweight design ensures easy handling and installation, making it suitable for professional plumbers and experienced DIYers working on drainage solutions. The push-fit system with ring seal joints simplifies connection, while the two boss inlets accommodate 32 and 40mm waste pipes. Designed for high temperature waste discharges, it ensures a robust and long-lasting connection. The use of silicone lubricant on all seals will facilitate jointing.
